import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Use current data
# Build experimental dataframe from objects we explicitly created in this cell history if available
# exp_all should exist from prior cell
print("exp_all shape:", exp_all.shape)
print(exp_all.head())

# Fit marker ~ cohort on experiments
X = exp_all[["cohort"]].values
y = exp_all["marker"].values
lr_m = LinearRegression().fit(X, y)
print("\nmarker ~ cohort: intercept, coef, R2")
print(lr_m.intercept_, lr_m.coef_, lr_m.score(X, y))
resid_m = y - lr_m.predict(X)
print("marker resid std:", resid_m.std())

# Fit outcome mean by dose/cohort with additive cohort and saturating dose basis
tmp = exp_all.groupby(["cohort","dose"], as_index=False)["outcome"].mean()
for k in [0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0]:
    Z = np.column_stack([
        np.ones(len(tmp)),
        tmp["cohort"].values,
        1 - np.exp(-k * tmp["dose"].values)
    ])
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, tmp["outcome"].values, rcond=None)
    pred = Z @ beta
    rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((tmp["outcome"].values - pred)**2))
    print(f"k={k:.2f} beta={beta} rmse={rmse:.4f}")

# Inspect observational natural dose distribution
print("\nObs dose mean/std:", obs["dose"].mean(), obs["dose"].std())
print("Obs zero fraction:", np.mean(obs["dose"] == 0))
print("Obs positive dose summary:")
pos = obs.loc[obs["dose"] > 0, "dose"]
print(pos.describe())

# One more cohort point to estimate linearity
extra = env.experiment(config={"dose": 5.0}, context={"cohort": 0.75}, n=220)
extra["cohort"] = 0.75
print("\nExtra cohort=0.75 dose=5 means:")
print(extra[["marker","outcome"]].mean())
exp_all = pd.concat([exp_all, extra], ignore_index=True)

# Refit quick preferred form after extra point
tmp = exp_all.groupby(["cohort","dose"], as_index=False)["outcome"].mean()
k = 0.35
Z = np.column_stack([
    np.ones(len(tmp)),
    tmp["cohort"].values,
    1 - np.exp(-k * tmp["dose"].values)
])
beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, tmp["outcome"].values, rcond=None)
pred = Z @ beta
print("\nPreferred fit k=0.35 beta, rmse")
print(beta, np.sqrt(np.mean((tmp["outcome"].values - pred)**2)))

print("\nRemaining budget:", env.describe().get("budget_remaining"))

    A = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(cohorts)), cohorts])
    beta_m, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, markers, rcond=None)
    resid_m = markers - A @ beta_m
    print("\nmarker beta [intercept, cohort_coef]:", beta_m)
    print("marker resid std:", resid_m.std())

    tmp = exp_all.groupby(["cohort","dose"], as_index=False)["outcome"].mean()

            1 - np.exp(-k * tmp["dose"].values)

        pred = Z @ beta
        rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((tmp["outcome"].values - pred)**2))

MARKER_B0 = {float(m0)!r}
MARKER_B1 = {float(m1)!r}
MARKER_SD = {float(max(resid_m.std(), 1e-6))!r}

OUT_B1 = {float(o1)!r}
